title: Pretty Disappointing
text:
Pretty Disappointing. I am not impressed. We bought two of these rugs for our bathroom. The first day we lay the rugs down, we notice one is fraying pretty badly. Quality is low.
Another disappointment is how long these stay wet. I would not re-buy these. We'll use them in our apartment and toss when we move out.
The only plus on these is that they do look nice.
